lines: As part of the holistic education concept of NEP-2020, students will be provided opportunity for internships at industry/organisation in order to help them get exposure to practical side of learning.
URSC, one of the leading Centres of ISRO, provides opportunity for student's community to carry out Internship as well as project work as part of their academic curriculum.
Internship Opportunity is provided UG/PG/PhD student. The period of Internship will be for a minimum period of 15 days and maximum period of 45 days.
Following are the guidelines for pursuing Internship in URSC:
The candidate should be Citizen of India
The candidate should be pursuing UG/PG/PhD from a recognized University/Institution (India/Abroad)
The candidate should have completed UG/PG from a recognized University/Institution, seeking internship opportunity within 6 months from the date of completion of Course.
The candidate should be a student enrolled for regular on-campus programme in a recognized University/Institution
The candidate should have completed UG/PG/PhD as a regular on campus student
No Stipend, transport & canteen facility will be provided during the training
The students should have possessed aggregate of minimum 60% or CGPA 6.32 on a scale of 10.
Students will be allotted internship work at URSC based on the availability of projects, facilities and suitability of student's course to the work carried out at URSC.
The allotment of internship will be on
first come first serve basis only
and the availability of number of slots per year is limited.
Year onwards are eligible for applying.
The interns will not be provided any kind of financial assistance like stipends and accommodation.
Documents to be uploaded while applying for internship:
Request/Permisson letter from Principal / HOD for carrying out internship at URSC, mentioning duration of the same. Letter should be duly signed and sealed by the college authority.
